title: Termination and credential revocation need timestamped sponsor evidence
remediation: The sponsor human resources, identity and asset leads define termination notification, access disablement deadline, credential revocation, exit topics and asset recovery. Sample a termination or authorized exercise against the deadline and verify reassignment or retained access to organizational information. Record inherited directory actions at their assessed boundary.

milestones.title: Collect a redacted termination workflow with access timestamps, credential and asset recovery and transfer of organizational information
